name: cat-edge-Cooking
description: Hypergraph where nodes are food ingredients, hyperedges are recipes made from combining multiple ingredients and categories indicate cuisine (e.g., Southern-US, Indian, Spanish).

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., cat-edge-Cooking).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the food ingredient (e.g., romaine lettuce).

edges_metadata.label: (STRING) Cuisine category assigned to the recipe hyperedge (e.g., greek).
